cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant city known for its iconic Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Famous for its cultural diversity, lively arts scene, world-class coffee, and historic laneways.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A bustling metropolis blending ultra-modern skyscrapers with historic temples and shrines.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Known for numerous classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, and traditional wooden houses.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A massive Buddhist temple complex located in northern Cambodia and the largest religious monument in the world.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An iconic ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna in Agra, India.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: An iconic tropical island surrounded by sand-fringed motus and a turquoise lagoon protected by a coral reef.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: A world-famous crescent-shaped beach located in the vibrant city of Rio de Janeiro, known for its lively atmosphere.
